Class SelectiveAccessFilter

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.transport.SelectiveAccessFilter
public final class SelectiveAccessFilter extends Object
Typed builder for the selective-access filter map passed to WorkbenchTransportClient.download(String, java.util.Map, WorkbenchHandshake.OutputMode, int).

The underlying handshake already validates filter keys against WorkbenchHandshake.ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_FILTER_KEYS -- this builder narrows the API to typed setters so the GUI's filter form (W5.3) cannot accidentally produce a key the server will reject.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.transport.selective_access.SelectiveAccessFilter.
